Your Opportunity

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together.

As a Manager (AI & Data Science) you will be part of the Deposit Modeling and Analytics team within the Treasury & Capital Market department. The Deposit Modeling and Analytics team is responsible for data-driven deposit analytics, developing models for deposit forecasting and pricing, and generating deposit forecasts on a recurring cadence.

This role will give you the opportunity to analyze large scale and complex datasets. You are not afraid to get your hands dirty: sorting out data issues, organizing datasets, using your math/stats skills to generate insights, developing new models, improving the efficacy of existing models, and solving problems is what you love to do. With your strong programming skills, you will find scalable and robust solutions to automate and visualize our analytics. In all these endeavors, you will cooperate closely with your team and other stakeholders to achieve the best possible outcome.

As a member of this team, you will contribute critical insights that directly influence senior management decisions. If this sounds exciting to you, we look forward to receiving your application.

• Bachelor’s degree with a strong quantitative component (Applied Math, Statistics, Economics, Physics, Financial Engineering), a graduate degree is a plus (Master/Ph.D.)
• Ability to develop new models, improve efficacy of existing models and rigorously test them.
• Minimum of 3 years previous modelling/analytics work experience in a financial company
• Solid understanding of statistical concepts and practical experience using statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets
• Strong programming skills in a modern programming language (e.g., Python, C++)
• Advanced experience in extracting data from relational databases (e.g., via SQL)
• Strong work ethic, high self-motivation, proactive approach, and attention to detail
• Strong communication and inter-personal skills
• Collaborative team-player
• Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint

What you'll do:
• Develop robust models which measure the market risk in financial projections associated with a diverse set of deposit products across the balance sheet.
• Support Balance Sheet and Product teams by enhancing existing and developing new reporting and analytical capabilities that describe the deposit portfolios.
• Contribute to the future state of model development infrastructure and data patterns toward advancing AI/ML capabilities.
• Leverage industry opportunities to expand the organization’s capabilities in data science, engineering, and modeling techniques.

At Schwab, we’re committed to empowering our employees’ personal and professional success. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

job_title: Help me develop Project Scope for AI Photo & Video Editing Software that we can train ourselves
job_description:
It's pretty straightforward - basically I run my own photography and video production company and we are growing fast. One of our bottlenecks is taking our raw data and converting it into the best video clips or photos, applying some basic edits to them, merging HDR images, and then having them come out the other end to our standards.

There would be two aspects:

1) Photo Selection, HDR Merging, Editing, and Renaming plus exporting in different sizes and formats

2) Video Clip Selection (bad clips from good clips), Stabilizing, Color Correcting, Improving Audio, Renaming, and Exporting Clips

We are already preparing to train this AI right now. For example, we'll fly our drone and might be recording video clips while we get the drone calibrated, so some clips are shaky, jerky, and 'bad'. Then we'll fly the drone in a nice, smooth, planned shot and that will be a good clip. So we already have multiple hours of footage where we have the RAW clips in one folder, the before video footage, and then we have the after clips where we cut out all of the 'bad' clips and then we color correct and export the 'good clips'. The hope is to create a project scope with an AI Machine learning expert (you) to help us know what exactly we need to do to create an AI Software that can be taught, with us giving it hours of footage to train from that are 'good shots' and 'bad shots' so that eventually we could just drop in a video clip, and it has learned what is bad and good, so it just cuts out all the bad clips, keeps the good clips, stabilizes them and color corrects them and then we are able to move forward with our business much faster.

I'd like to be able to do a similar service with photo editing. We have two types of editing we need a software/machine learning AI to help with for this project. One type is when we capture a darker photo, a properly exposed middle photo, and a brighter photo - then we merge those images together using software such as 'Photomatix' or 'Aurora HDR' which blends the best lighting conditions from each of the photos. The darker photo you can see through windows for example, but any shadows inside the building are almost black, but in the really bright photo, you can see the color and details in the shadow areas, but the window is blown out and bright white. But by merging the photos, you can see outside the window and into the shadow area.

So creating a HDR merging software similar to these softwares is an eventual project we will need help with, but in the meantime we can continue using these softwares, but the second aspect of the photo editing AI machine learning I want help with is having raw unedited photos go into it, and then it spits out perfectly edited and color balanced images on the back end.

We already have thousands of photo examples prepared, where we have the before images and then the edited after images that have the edits, color, and feel that we want.

I need help to understand the project scope of what is the cost, the process step by step, and the vehicles for finding, integrating, and training AI machine learning so that by the end of this process we can drop in any photos or any video clips and it will follow the training we have given it to quickly process and export great video clips and photos edited to our standards that were trained to be matched.

If you end up being an excellent fit for our team, this could turn into a job helping us develop the AI - but right now I'm strictly looking for someone to help me develop the project scope. Preferably someone who has done something like this before and fully understands the process.

I look forward to hearing from you, please let me know previous projects you have developed and why you believe you know best what steps need to be followed to develop this photo & video editing AI.

Thank you!

M365 Research and the Privacy Preserving Machine Learning Initiative are looking for a Senior Researcher to explore privacy and confidentiality aspects of machine learning. The role offers the unique opportunity to work in close collaboration with colleagues in Microsoft Research (MSR), Azure Research, Microsoft 365 and other product groups. Our researchers pursue innovation in a range of scientific and technical disciplines to help solve complex challenges in diverse fields, including private and efficient AI, AIOps, and responsible AI, with applications to a wide range of business, consumer, and scientific domains.

We are seeking candidates to explore various topics of PPML, including:
• Privacy mitigations in machine learning, such as differentially private (DP) training, with an emphasis on Large Language Models (LLMs),
• Advancing approaches for synthetic data generation with privacy guarantees,
• Auditing privacy mitigations,
• Privacy attacks, including membership inference, poisoning attacks, and reconstruction attacks,
• Privacy vs fairness tensions in AI systems,
• Private and trustworthy grounding in retrieval-augmented systems,
• Novel applications of privacy-enhancing technologies (PETs), including but not limited to applications of DP, multi-party computation, and confidential computing.
• Federated Learning and analytics,
• Multi-party data collaboration

We encourage senior researchers with relevant technical background in any of these topics to apply. This role is located in Redmond and is co-located with Microsoft Research.

Required/Minimum Qualifications
• Doctorate in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Machine Learning or related fields
• OR equivalent experience.
• Experience publishing as a lead or essential author in top conferences/journals in at least one of the following areas: machine learning, privacy, security, responsible AI, federated learning, natural language processing, computer vision.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications
• Background in machine learning and deep learning; experience with large language models and their applications in areas such as text generation, sentiment analysis, language translation, or conversational AI. Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-source LLMs;
• Familiarity with state-of-the-art practices and methodologies in security and privacy such as differential privacy, information flow control, secure multi-party computation, and homomorphic encryption;
• Track record in research, as evidenced by high-quality publications;
• Publications at leading NLP conferences such as NIPS, ICML, ICLR, EMNLP and ACL;
• Software development skills and experience, preferably deep learning frameworks such as Python and PyTorch.
